results.query: How do I get a refund?

hits.title: Returns & Refunds
hits.body: Not happy with your beans? Return any unopened bag within 30 days for a full refund. Opened bags qualify for store credit. Email support to start a refund.

hits.title: Pausing Your Subscription
hits.body: Need a break? Pause your subscription for up to three months from your account dashboard. Billing and shipments stop while paused and resume automatically.
